p: Put: Which ceremony declared, the servants obedience towards his master, and the master's power over the servant.
swear by the LORD: This shows that an oath may be required in a lawful cause.
country: He did not want his son to marry out of the godly family: for the problems that come from marrying the ungodly are set forth in various places throughout the scriptures.
thither again: Lest he should love the inheritance promised.
city of Nahor: That is, to Charran.
LORD God of my master Abraham: He grounds his prayer on God's promise made to his master.
And let it come to pass: The servant moved by God's spirit sought assurance by a sign, as to whether or not God would prosper his journey.
Rebekah came out: God gives success to all things that are done for the glory of his name and according to his word.
went down to the well: Here is declared that God hears the prayers of his own, and grants their requests.
earring of: God permitted many things both in apparel and other things which are now forbidden especially when they do not suit our humble estate.
half a shekel weight: The golden shekel is meant here, not silver.
and his truth: He does not boast in his good fortune (as the wicked do) but acknowledges that God has dealt mercifully with this matter in keeping his promise.
he stood by the camels at: For he waited on God's hand, who heard his prayer.
he ungirded his: That is, Laban.
camels: The gentle entertainment of strangers practised by the godly fathers.
will not eat: The faithfulness that servants owe to their masters, causes them to prefer their masters business before their own needs.
blessed my master greatly: To bless signifies here to enrich, or increase with substance as the text in the same verse declares.
Thou shalt not take a wife: The Canaanites were cursed, and therefore the godly could not join with them in marriage.
father's house: Meaning among his relatives, as in Ge 24:40.
my oath: Which by my authority I caused you to make.
heart: Signifying that this prayer was not spoken by the mouth, but only in his heart.
And I bowed down my head: He shows our duty when we have received any benefit from the Lord.
kindly and truly with my master: If you will freely and faithfully give your daughter to my master's son.
right hand: That is, that I may look elsewhere.
The thing proceedeth from the LORD: As soon as they perceived that it was God's ordinance they yielded.
her mouth: This shows that parents do not have the authority to marry their children without the consent of both parties.
gate of those which hate them: That is, let them be victorious over their enemies: a blessing that is fully accomplished through Jesus Christ.

meditate in the field at the: This was the habit of the godly fathers to meditate on God's promises, and to pray for the accomplishment of it. The custom was that the bride was brought to her husband, her head covered, a token of humbleness and purity.
